summary.en: Markets edge higher in early trading with S&P +0.6%, Nasdaq +0.7% despite lingering AI valuation concerns and chip sector weakness from Korean peers (-10%). Oil continues selloff below $72 amid Iran peace progress, while gold tests support at $4,000 as strong dollar and Fed rate hike bets weigh on precious metals.
summary.zh: 市场在早盘小幅上涨，标普指数 +0.6%，纳指 +0.7%，尽管 AI 估值担忧和对韩国芯片股疲弱的持续影响（-10%）。油价在地缘政治缓和背景下继续下跌至 $72 以下，黄金因美元走强和美联储加息赌注而测试$4,000支撑位。

title.en: Tech Selloff Eases in Early Session: AI Valuation Jitters Offset by Oil Price Relief
title.zh: 早盘科技抛售缓和：油价缓解抵消了 AI 估值忧虑

impact.en: Market sentiment improving as broader chip weakness stabilizes. Tech rotation continues but oil relief helps offset inflation repricing concerns.
impact.zh: 随着更广泛的芯片股疲软趋于稳定，市场情绪改善。技术板块轮动持续但油价缓解有助于抵消通胀重定价担忧。

macroRisk.en: Mixed - Oil disinflation helps CPI but sector divergence (AI hardware vs. software) creates volatility.
macroRisk.zh: 分化——油价通缩有助于通胀但板块轮动（硬件软件）造成波动。

title.en: WTI Crude Falls Below $72 as Hormuz Flows Improve and Peace Talks Offset Geopolitical Premium
title.zh: WTI 原油跌破$72，霍尔木兹流量改善和平谈判抵消地缘政治溢价

impact.en: Oil prices drop further despite energy sector resilience. Supply glut fears vs OPEC+ restraint remain key balance point.
impact.zh: 尽管能源板块表现强劲，油价进一步下跌。供应过剩担忧与 OPEC+克制之间的平衡是关键焦点。

macroRisk.en: Low-Medium - Energy disinflation eases inflation but risks GDP downside if too aggressive.
macroRisk.zh: 低-中等——能源通缩缓解通胀但若过于激进可能拖累经济。

title.en: Gold Dips to $4,000 Support Zone as Dollar Strength and Fed Hiking Narrative Suppress Safe-Haven Demand
title.zh: 金价跌至$4,000 支撑区域，美元走强和美联储加息叙事压制避险需求

impact.en: Precious metals under pressure from yield-sensitive positioning. Gold's safe-haven appeal intact but secondary to rate expectations.
impact.zh: 贵金属受收益率敏感配置影响而承压。黄金的避险属性完好但次要于利率预期。

macroRisk.en: Medium - Dollar strength and yield volatility create downside pressure on precious metals.
macroRisk.zh: 中等——美元走强和收益率波动对贵金属构成下行压力。

title.en: Korean Semiconductor Weakness (-10%) Creates Cross-Border Contagion Concerns for US Chip Names
title.zh: 韩国半导体疲软（-10%）引发美国芯片股跨境传染担忧

impact.en: Supply chain exposure to Asian peers amplifies volatility. NVIDIA/Cadence/Broadcom face indirect pressure through ecosystem linkages.
impact.zh: 对亚洲同行的供应链暴露放大了波动性。NVIDIA/ Cadence/Broadcom 通过生态系统联动面临间接压力。

macroRisk.en: Yes - Supply chain contagion risk for AI hardware complex.
macroRisk.zh: 是——对 AI 硬件复杂体的供应链传染风险。

title.en: Micron Earnings Preview: Memory Cycle Rebound or Another Valuation Squeeze Ahead?
title.zh: 美光财报前瞻：存储周期反弹还是估值挤压的又一次考验？

impact.en: Semiconductor sector faces earnings scrutiny amid valuation reset. Early results may signal whether AI demand remains sustainable.
impact.zh: 半导体板块在重置估值之际面临盈利审查。早期结果可能显示 AI 需求是否可持续。

macroRisk.en: Low - Earnings clarity needed to confirm sector fundamentals amid macro noise.
macroRisk.zh: 低——需要在宏观噪音中确认板块基本面的盈利清晰度。

title.en: Fed Speaker Warsh Hints at Rate Stability: Markets Weigh Q2 Inflation Data vs Growth Concerns
title.zh: 美联储官员沃什暗示利率稳定：市场权衡 6Q 通胀数据与增长担忧

impact.en: Policy signals moderate yield trajectory but uncertainty on pivot timing affects duration-sensitive growth stocks.
impact.zh: 政策信号缓和收益率路径但转向时机不确定影响久期敏感的成长股。

macroRisk.en: Low - Policy signals already priced; key watch is inflation data prints.
macroRisk.zh: 低——政策信号已反映；关键观察通胀数据发布。

title.en: DXY Strength Persists as Dollar Aids EM Assets and Multinationals Face Currency Headwinds
title.zh: 美元指数持续走强，美元助推新兴市场资产而跨国企业面临汇率阻力

impact.en: Strong dollar weighs on export-oriented tech (Apple, Tesla) but supports energy sector revenues in USD terms.
impact.zh: 强势美元压制出口导向型科技（苹果、特斯拉）但支持能源板块以美元计价的营收。

macroRisk.en: Mixed - Beneficial for commodity exporters but harmful to multinationals with overseas exposure.
macroRisk.zh: 分化——有利于大宗商品出口商但对海外暴露的跨国企业不利。

ai.en: AI complex stabilizes after selloff as broader market rallies. Valuation compression continues but hardware supply chain concerns ease. NVDA under pressure from Korean chip weakness contagion.
ai.zh: AI 复杂体在市场整体上涨后企稳。估值压缩持续但对硬件供应链担忧缓和。NVDA 受到韩国芯片疲软传染而承压。

semiconductor.en: Mixed sector performance with hardware (memory chips) facing earnings scrutiny while software/design names stabilize. Korean peer weakness creates cross-border volatility but demand remains resilient.
semiconductor.zh: 半导体板块表现分化，硬件（存储芯片）面临盈利审查而软件/设计股企稳。韩国同行疲软造成跨境波动但需求保持韧性。

bigTech.en: Nasdaq gains +0.7% as chip sector stabilization offsets Mag-7 concerns. Apple, Microsoft lead recovery amid rotation from overextended AI hardware into software and services.
bigTech.zh: 纳指上涨 0.7%，芯片板块企稳抵消了Mag-7担忧。苹果、微软在从过度超值的AI硬件轮动至软件服务之际引领复苏。

energy.en: Energy sector outperforms on oil price decline paradoxically - earnings discipline and production cuts support prices despite lower WTI/Brent. OPEC+ restraint balances supply glut fears.
energy.zh: 能源板块在油价下跌的悖论中表现优于其他——盈利纪律和生产削减支持价格，尽管WTI/布伦特更低。OPEC+克制平衡供应过剩担忧。

ev.en: EV names (NIO, LI) face pressure from dollar strength and tech rotation headwinds. Macro uncertainty dominates sector outlook; demand fundamentals mixed amid policy signals.
ev.zh: 电动车股（蔚来、理想）受美元走强和科技轮动阻力影响承压。宏观不确定性主导板块展望；需求基本面在政策信号中呈现分化。

market.en: Risk-on sentiment prevails with S&P +0.6%, Nasdaq +0.7%. Breadth improving as chip weakness contained to specific hardware names. Treasury yields volatile on rate hike bets.
market.zh: 风险偏好情绪主导，标普指数 +0.6%，纳指 +0.7%。随着芯片疲软局限于特定硬件股而广度改善。美债收益率在加息赌注下波动。

preciousMetals.en: Gold tests $4,000 support zone with selling pressure from rate sensitivity and dollar strength intact. Safe-haven appeal secondary to Fed expectations but underlying demand supports floor.
preciousMetals.zh: 黄金测试$4,000支撑区，抛售压力因利率敏感性和美元走强而存在。避险属性次要于美联储预期但底层需求支持底线。

oil.en: WTI crude below $72 as peace talks advance and Hormuz flows improve. Oil price disinflation eases inflation fears but geopolitical premium compresses amid US-Iran ceasefire progress.
oil.zh: WTI 原油低于$72，和平谈判进展和霍尔木兹流量改善。油价通缩缓解通胀担忧但地缘政治溢价在美伊停火进程中压缩。

futures.en: S&P futures tick higher after overnight gains; Nasdaq, Dow stabilize with chip sector relief. Asia mixed but improving sentiment from Korean semis stabilization.
futures.zh: 标普期指在隔夜上涨后小幅走高；纳指、道指随芯片板块缓解而稳定。亚洲市场分化但改善情绪因韩国半导体企稳而上升。

treasury10Y.en: 10Y Treasury yields volatile amid rate hike bets vs. inflation data uncertainty. Yield fluctuations signal policy transition phase affecting duration-sensitive growth names.
treasury10Y.zh: 10Y 美债收益率在加息赌注和通胀数据不确定性间波动。收益率波动显示政策过渡期影响久期敏感的成长股名称。

dxy.en: Dollar index maintains strength as dollar aids EM assets while multinationals face currency headwinds. Strong USD weighs on tech exports but benefits energy sector revenues.
dxy.zh: 美元指数保持强势，美元助推新兴市场资产而跨国企业面临汇率阻力。强势美元压制科技出口但有利于能源板块营收。

oil.en: Oil prices trade below $72 as peace hopes dominate headlines. WTI/Brent volatility elevated but disinflation narrative supports lower price regime despite supply risks.
oil.zh: 油价交易于$72 以下，和平希望主导头条新闻。WTI/布伦特波动率升高但通缩叙事支持较低价格格局尽管存在供应风险。

keyRisk.en: AI valuation compression spreading to broader tech amid Korean chip weakness and earnings season ahead. Oil disinflation vs supply disruption balance; Fed pivot timing uncertainty.
keyRisk.zh: 在亚洲芯片疲软和财报季临近之际，AI 估值压缩蔓延至更广泛科技板块。油价通缩与供应中断平衡；美联储转向时机不确定。

note.en: Mixed sentiment: broader market rally offsets chip sector weakness. Risk-on bias with oil relief and dollar strength, but AI valuation concerns and earnings uncertainty create selective trading opportunities.
note.zh: 情绪分化：市场整体反弹抵消了芯片板块疲软。风险偏好受油价缓解和美元走强影响，但AI 估值担忧和盈利不确定性创造了选择性交易机会。
